summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bali Tour website layout update with new interactive features. All major functionality working perfectly including expandable destinations, interactive Leaflet map with draggable markers, inline booking form, and region filtering.

design_issues.issue: Console hydration warnings for span elements inside tbody and select (does not affect functionality)

passed_tests: Homepage loads correctly with hero section and Duta Bali logo
Tour packages section displays 6 tour cards with expandable destinations
Tour Destinations button expands/collapses destination details correctly
Interactive Leaflet map loads with tiles and draggable marker
Map marker can be dragged to new positions successfully
Location table has clickable rows that update map marker position
Region tabs (South Bali, West Bali, East Bali, etc.) filter locations correctly
Coordinates display updates when location is selected (-8.6478, 115.1385)
Open in Google Maps button generates correct URL with coordinates
Inline booking form (not modal) displays and functions correctly
All form fields accept input (name, email, WhatsApp, date, notes)
Tour package selection works and triggers price calculation
Location selection with surcharge updates total price correctly
Price calculation accurate: Best of Ubud (750,000) + Kuta (300,000) = 1,050,000
Submit booking button enables after required fields filled
Send Reservation button triggers WhatsApp integration
Floating WhatsApp button works with correct number (+62 838-7122-5179)
Navigation links scroll to correct sections (packages, locations, reviews, booking)
Hero Book Now button scrolls to booking section
Reserve This Tour buttons pre-select packages in booking form
Mobile navigation menu opens/closes correctly
Responsive design works on Desktop (1920x1080), Tablet (768x1024), Mobile (390x844)
All sections (hero, stats, packages, locations, reviews, booking, footer) load correctly
No critical JavaScript errors or broken functionality found
